notes: New: Settings > Backup & restore (admins). Download backup makes one password-protected file with everything needed to bring Diastema back after a failed update, a reinstall or a move to a new server (users and PINs, follow-ups, tasks, history, settings, header image, the Open Dental connection and the phone-calls pairing). Restore from Settings, or from the setup page of a fresh install ('Restore from a backup file instead'): the file and password are checked first, Diastema restarts to finish, and the data it replaced is kept in backups\before-restore-...
